name: shin
title: Shin and foot
orientation: The bar and the foot flat on the bed, the boss up. The foot's V groove at 45° needs no support
description: From the knee's output flange to a round foot: a bar in one piece with the disc the grip pad snaps round.

bar.rule: The bar's thickness, sized in the chapter: 2 MPa under the worst stance load

wide.rule: The bar's width at the knee

toe.rule: Its width at the foot: tapered, as the bending falls to nothing at the foot

boss.rule: The bar passes under the knee's clips, the boss above reaches the flange

head.rule: The screw's head, counterbored in the bed side

foot_w.rule: The foot's width across the leg: wide enough to stand on the pad's tread

foot_r.rule: The disc's radius, under the pad

pad_t.rule: The pad's thickness, its tread included

groove.rule: The V groove the pad's ridge locks into, 1 mm deep: at 45° it prints without support
